rule_or_requirement: A candidate-only off-track retirement must be traced to an observable action boundary before changing launch or preview behavior.
observable_information: Frozen candidate ZIP base launch action, final preview action, preview activation, seven current/previous pixel road centers, pixel speed and obstacle diagnostic; evaluator-only position, heading and road progress.
allowed_action_or_state_change: No candidate action change. Evaluation-only instrumentation records the two wrapper actions on consumed track 3 seed 7040.
expected_success_endpoint: An aligned step-by-step trace identifying whether preview action changes precede the observed late path divergence and whether the original candidate-only failure reproduces.
control: Exact selected full-road-guard ZIP SHA-256 5c55670ab5aef4bf64115909792650a5e76bc3576a64f3aaeb3780efabc18e40 on the same consumed cell.
falsifier: ZIP/hash mismatch, failure not reproduced, instrumentation changes final actions, missing base/final action alignment, or inference leaks evaluator state.
smallest_decisive_experiment: One paired exact-ZIP replay at track 3 seed 7040, with per-decision wrapper-boundary instrumentation and full evaluator trace. It is not fresh completion evidence.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local diagnostic profile only, two episodes, 2000 decisions each, 2 CPU, 2 GiB, 600 seconds; no site action.
